name: evaluate-review-skills
description: Discover in-tree SKILL.md files across the Fuchsia checkout (including vendor/google when present), evaluate skills in parallel for inclusion in .agents/code-review/agent_configs.textproto (used by both local /review and Gerrit CRACS), and cross-check recommendations.

workspace_root.description: Optional Fuchsia checkout root directory (defaults to current workspace directory).

repo.description: Repository to scan for SKILL.md files: 'all' (fuchsia.git plus vendor/google when present, default), 'fuchsia', or 'vendor/google'.

path_prefix.description: Optional repo-relative path prefix to restrict skill discovery (e.g. 'src/storage' or 'build').

only_unregistered.description: If true (default), only evaluate skills not yet referenced in .agents/code-review/agent_configs.textproto (fuchsia.git or vendor/google).

since_date.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD) for measuring git commit volume in target paths (defaults dynamically to 2 months before the run date).

min_commits.description: Minimum commit count since since_date required in target paths to recommend adding or keeping an agent_configs.textproto entry.

max_concurrency.description: Maximum number of parallel skill evaluator agents to run concurrently.

report_path.description: Optional absolute path to write the Markdown evaluation report.
